# Improvement Request for http://127.0.0.1:9902/

## Quality Assessment
Score: 40/100 — Verdict: fail

## Issues to Fix (4 unique, 0 duplicates)

### [HIGH] All navigation routes except Board show the Project Board (My Tasks, Team, Reports, Sign In never render)
- **Observed:** Verified three ways: (1) clicked link "My Tasks" by role/name — URL became #tasks, content unchanged after 1.5s wait; (2) clicked "Team" and "Reports" — same result; (3) opened a fresh tab directly at #login — the Project Board with kanban columns rendered instead of a login form. No console errors accompany this, so the router appears to always fall through to the board view.
- **Expected:** Each nav link should display its own view: My Tasks, Team, Reports, and a Sign In form.
- **Impact:** 4 of the 5 navigation destinations are unreachable; users can never see their tasks, the team page, reports, or reach the login screen. On mobile (393px) the Sign In link is additionally pushed off-screen, so there is no way at all to reach sign-in.
- **Prompt:** Fix: All navigation routes except Board show the Project Board (My Tasks, Team, Reports, Sign In never render). Expected behavior: Each nav link should display its own view: My Tasks, Team, Reports, and a Sign In form.. Current behavior: Only the Project Board view ever renders. Clicking each nav link updates the URL hash (to #tasks, #team, #reports) but the content stays "Project Board + Add Task + kanban columns". Even a fresh page load directly at http://127.0.0.1:9902/#login renders the Project Board instead of a sign-in form.. Reproduction: Open http://127.0.0.1:9902/ → Click 'My Tasks' in the header (URL changes to #tasks) → Observe the page content → Repeat for 'Team', 'Reports', and load http://127.0.0.1:9902/#login directly

### [HIGH] Header overflows viewport on mobile: 'Sign In' link is cut off and unclickable at 393px
- **Observed:** Snapshot geometry: Sign In anchor at x=398.16, width 30.55 in a 393px viewport. Nav links are laid out in one row (Board x=149, My Tasks x=210, Team x=267, Reports x=324, Sign In x=398) with no wrapping. browser_click by role/name timed out: 'element may be hidden or not yet rendered'.
- **Expected:** All header links fit within the mobile viewport, ideally via a responsive/wrapping or collapsing nav (hamburger menu).
- **Impact:** On an iPhone-class device the authentication entry point is invisible and unreachable; combined with the routing defect, users cannot sign in at all on mobile.
- **Prompt:** Fix: Header overflows viewport on mobile: 'Sign In' link is cut off and unclickable at 393px. Expected behavior: All header links fit within the mobile viewport, ideally via a responsive/wrapping or collapsing nav (hamburger menu).. Current behavior: The Sign In link's bounding box is x=398..428 at a 393px viewport — entirely off the right edge. The header does not wrap and the page cannot scroll horizontally to it (attempted horizontal scroll; positions unchanged). A Playwright-style click on the link times out because it is not visible.. Reproduction: Set viewport to 393×852 (iPhone 15) → Open http://127.0.0.1:9902/ → Inspect the header navigation area

### [MEDIUM] Add Task form gives no feedback when submitted with an empty title
- **Observed:** DOM bodyText after empty Create contains no error strings; screenshots of the modal show no message. A second empty submit after scrolling confirmed the same. Task count stayed at To Do (3).
- **Expected:** Submitting the New Task form with an empty Title should show a visible validation error (e.g. "Title is required") explaining why the task was not created.
- **Impact:** Users who tap Create without typing a title get zero feedback and may believe the app is broken. Basic form usability/validation feedback is missing.
- **Prompt:** Fix: Add Task form gives no feedback when submitted with an empty title. Expected behavior: Submitting the New Task form with an empty Title should show a visible validation error (e.g. "Title is required") explaining why the task was not created.. Current behavior: The modal stays open, no task is created, and no validation message, error text, or field highlight appears anywhere on the page (confirmed in both full-page text and screenshots). The form simply does nothing.. Reproduction: Open http://127.0.0.1:9902/#board → Tap '+ Add Task' → Leave Title empty and tap 'Create'

### [MEDIUM] Task changes are lost on reload: created tasks and status moves reset to seed data
- **Observed:** Sequence: added "QA smoke task" (To Do showed 3), clicked "Write documentation" card (moved to In Progress, To Do showed 1). After reloading http://127.0.0.1:9902/, board shows To Do (2) with "Write documentation" back in it and no "QA smoke task". Network log shows only the document GET; no state-saving API calls exist.
- **Expected:** Created tasks and status changes should survive a page reload (via backend API or local storage).
- **Impact:** Any task a user adds or advances is silently discarded when the page is refreshed or reopened. For a project management tool, users lose their work with no warning.
- **Prompt:** Fix: Task changes are lost on reload: created tasks and status moves reset to seed data. Expected behavior: Created tasks and status changes should survive a page reload (via backend API or local storage).. Current behavior: The board resets to the initial five seeded tasks. The task created during testing ("QA smoke task") disappeared, and a task moved from To Do to In Progress ("Write documentation") was back in To Do after reload. The app issues no network requests other than the initial document GET, so state lives only in JS memory.. Reproduction: Open http://127.0.0.1:9902/ → Tap '+ Add Task', enter a title, tap 'Create' — the task appears in To Do → Reload the page

## Instructions
Apply all fixes listed above. Prioritize critical and high severity issues first.
After fixing, regenerate the application for validation testing.

summary: Audited TaskBoard (http://127.0.0.1:9902/) at iPhone 15 size (393×852) with a desktop cross-check. The board itself renders and core interactions work: the kanban shows 4 columns with seeded tasks, the Add Task modal opens, a task with a title is created successfully, Cancel dismisses, and clicking a task card advances it to the next column. However, navigation is fundamentally broken: My Tasks, Team, Reports, and Sign In routes all render the Project Board regardless of whether the link is clicked or the URL is loaded directly, so 4 of 5 destinations (including authentication) are unreachable. On mobile the header also overflows, pushing the Sign In link entirely off-screen. Add Task gives no feedback on empty submit, and all task changes are lost on reload (in-memory state only). No console errors or failed network requests were observed. Verdict: pass with issues — the board flow functions, but routing, mobile navigation access, validation feedback, and persistence need fixing before release.
